name: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH)

ai_summary: The Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH) is organized by the Scenic Marathon Series and takes place on November 1, 2026, at Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Registration is currently open for those interested in taking part.
